title: salix eriophylla
intro: Salix eriophylla, commonly known as the Coyote Willow or Goat Willow, is a species of willow tree native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Salix eriophylla include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and wounds. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and salicylic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
